question: Kokborok is one of the state languages of Tripura. On 19th January 2022, Tripura celebrated which Kokborok day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**44th**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tripura **celebrated the **44th Kokborok Day** on **19th January 2022**.
 
• Kokborok is one of the** state languages** of Tripura, predominantly spoken by the Tripuri people.
 
• The celebration of Kokborok Day marks the recognition and promotion of the Kokborok language and its cultural significance.
 
• The day is observed with various cultural programs, events, and activities aimed at preserving and promoting the language.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kokborok, also known as Tripuri, is a **Tibeto-Burman language **spoken in the Indian state of Tripura and neighboring areas.
 
• The language has a rich oral tradition and has been an integral part of the cultural heritage of the indigenous Tripuri people.
 
• The Tripura government has taken several initiatives to promote the use of Kokborok in education and official communication.
 
• The celebration of Kokborok Day serves as a reminder of the importance of preserving indigenous languages and cultures.
